One of the best ambulance service i got for my mom.
My mom was not able to sit or walk but she want to go to gujarat from mumbai, approx 710km.

Everything and every service was beyond my imagination.

Special thanks to both ambulance drivers,
goaid team and MR DEV (who guided me) to book from go aid.

I had to go through an ordeal especially when I was taking a Senior citizen home. Made a terrible mistake booking with them. Would not recommend their services at all.
